_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: Cash account. Proceeds settle T+1. The account figure is the broker's, struck on the 0.46 option mark; on the 0.45 bid the position is worth 90.00 and the account 101.98. Deployable is 11.98 and that is the operative number - it buys no contract at all, so a second position is arithmetically closed off rather than declined.

positions.desc: 2 contracts @ 0.57 · long call · opened 10:46 ET by the operator
positions.noFly: None. Re-pulled live from the earnings calendar at 12:23 ET rather than carried forward: 1,518 events across 8/6–8/15 and SMR appears in none of them, so no print lands before the 8/14 expiry.
positions.note: No level hit at 12:23. Target 0.684 needs the bid up 52.0%, the 0.342 stop needs it down 24.0%, and the position is at -21.1% on the bid — about half the distance from entry to the stop, without reaching it. Time stop is session one of five. What changed this hour is the character of the loss rather than its level: last hour was two thirds decay, this hour is direction. SMR went 9.39 to 9.28 bid, -0.11, and at a 0.487 delta that alone accounts for -0.054 of a contract that moved -0.05 in mark. Cumulatively SMR is -1.75% from the 9.445 it was bought at, which explains roughly three quarters of the contract's -0.11. A decaying bet has become a losing one, which is worse to own and still not a level. Theta -0.0339 is 7.4% of mark a day, delta has slipped 0.5007 to 0.4728, break-even 9.96 needs SMR +7.3% in eight days, IV 98.8%. The spread is the one number that improved: 4.3% of mark on 454 traded into 791 open interest, so an exit when due is cheap to take. The dated item the pre-close run owns is the expiry, not a level — 8/14 is 8 days out today and 7 tomorrow, so the final week the rulebook says never to hold into begins at tomorrow's open, making today's 15:33 run the last that can act inside the rule.

entryWatch.trigger: Expired unexecuted at 10:35 ET — no equity order was ever placed against it
entryWatch.why: Fully resolved and left dead. The 09:47 specification's window ran out at 10:35 with no equity order of any state against it, and at 10:46 the operator opened 2 SMR 8/14 9.50 calls instead — the name from this board, the instrument from the operator. The 11:21 hourly adds the part the earlier runs could not yet see: the structural line the thesis rested on has broken. That line was the 9.505 8/5 high, and SMR is 9.39 bid, below it, having been 9.54 at 10:22 and 9.445 when the calls were bought. On the equity terms originally written this would now be a setup that failed rather than one that faded, which is worth recording precisely because the entry never filled — the specification's own level, 9.75, was never reachable after 10:22 and the thing that decided it was the 9.505 break, exactly as the 10:22 run said it would be. The option position carries its own levels and is tracked above; nothing about this dead equity setup revives, and no run should read the held calls as permission to add the shares underneath them.

entryWatch.trigger: Met and expired — held above 8.20, ran to +9.1%, has since faded back under the +8% line
entryWatch.why: Stays dead, and this hour is the one where that had to be re-argued rather than inherited. JOBY is 8.40 bid, +7.7% on the day, down from the 8.51 and +9.1% that disqualified it at 10:22 — so the single number item 2 names has slipped back under 8% and a run looking for a reason could call the objection expired. It is not, for two reasons that do not depend on the day's percentage. First, item 2 is about buying the reaction bar, and a name +7.7% having printed +9.1% intraday is still the reaction day; the rulebook wants the day-2/3 pullback, and day 2 is tomorrow. Second, and decisively at this account size, one share is all 11.98 of deployable cash would nearly buy at 8.41, and an -8% stop on it is 0.67 of room in a name that has already travelled 0.71 between its high and its current bid today. That is the identical stop-inside-the-noise objection that killed IONQ, and it is a property of the account against the name rather than a condition waiting to clear. Recorded because a disqualifier that lapses on a technicality is exactly how a chase gets written up as a setup.

entryWatch.trigger: Met — reclaimed the 41.37 opening print — but the disqualifier was never the trigger
entryWatch.why: Unchanged and unrevivable. IONQ is 41.22 bid, +3.2%, having faded from 41.57 at 10:22, so it is holding the reclaim of its 41.37 open only marginally. The trigger printing was never the question. At 41.22 a share the account cannot buy even one against 11.98 deployable, which has turned a stop-sits-inside-the-noise objection into a plain affordability one — the position size that made the -8% stop unusable is no longer reachable at all. Dead twice over.

entryWatch.trigger: None — the reclaim extended and does not revive it
entryWatch.why: Dead on structure, and the structure has not changed while the tape has. UPST is 30.81 bid, +2.0%, the strongest mover on the board this hour, up from 30.35 at 10:22 and now well clear of both the 30.20 close and the 30.32 pre-earnings line. Three hours of watching it reclaim more of the gap does not answer what killed it: 8/5 opened 34.595 and closed 30.20 on 12.3M shares against a 5.1M average, giving back the entire earnings move. A name working back up through a level it distributed through is not the pullback-after-strength the setup list wants, and the fact that it is now the best performer of the ones refused is the cost of that rule being written in advance rather than after the fact.

entryWatch.trigger: None available — item 2 forbids buying the +20% reaction bar
entryWatch.why: Dead, and still the clearest-paying refusal on the board. SOUN gapped from a 6.43 close to an 8.045 open, about +25%, and item 2 forbade it outright. It is 7.26 bid now: -9.8% from that open, having been -4.3% at 09:47 and -9.0% at 10:22. It has bled in every hour of the session while breadth went from 5 green of 12 to 9. Still +12.9% on the day, which is the whole point of tracking it — the daily change stays green while anyone who bought the open is down nearly 10% by lunchtime.

candidatesAsOf: 2026-08-06 12:23 ET, live session bids re-read by the mid-session run. The Last column is the official 8/5 settled close.
candidatesNote: Bids are live and quoted as bids, never marks. The account holds one position — the operator's 2 SMR 8/14 9.50 calls — and 11.98 of deployable settled cash, which closes off a second entry by arithmetic before any thesis is needed. The hour's fact is a breadth reversal: 5 green of 12 at 09:47, 8 at 10:22, 9 at 11:23, and 5 now. The board rolled over, and the names refused on rules gave back most of the hour that made them look right — IONQ +3.2% to +0.6%, UPST +2.0% to +0.1%, JOBY +7.7% to +6.5%, SOUN +12.9% to +11.7%. That retires the standing note that the board was rising while the pick was not: SMR at -1.1% is now mid-pack, ahead of QBTS, LEU, MARA, OKLO and RGTI. It vindicates nothing, and none of the refusals revive. MARA and RGTI report tonight and OKLO reports 8/7 before the open, all re-verified on the live calendar at 12:23, so all three stay no-fly for any five-session hold. SMCI reports 8/11 after the close, session four of a hold opened today. QBTS already reported this morning and its miss is behind it.

candidates.note: Held, as 2 8/14 9.50 calls rather than the shares this board specified. Bid 9.28, -1.1%, through the 9.38 close and down from 9.39 at 11:23 and 9.445 when the calls filled. It has been below the 9.505 8/5 high the thesis rested on for two hours and has now given up its own prior close as well. The contract's levels are all intact and none is hit; this hour the underlying supplied the loss rather than the clock, which is the worse of the two ways to be down.

Bid 8.31, +6.5%, fading a third consecutive hour from +9.1% to +7.7% to here. Still refused, and the fade does not change the reason: it is the reaction day, day 2 is tomorrow, and at one share an -8% stop is 0.66 of room in a name that has travelled 0.71 today. A stop inside a single session's range is not a stop.

Bid 40.15, +0.6%, having given back nearly the whole +3.2% it held at 11:23 and now well under the 41.37 open it reclaimed. The trigger it printed this morning has fully unwound. Academic either way: at 40.15 a share the account cannot buy one against 11.98 deployable.

Bid 7.18, +11.7% on the day but -10.8% from the 8.045 open, having been -4.3%, -9.0% and -9.8% at the three prior reads. It has now fallen in every hour of the session. Still the clearest-paying refusal on the board: the daily change stays green while anyone who bought the open is down nearly 11% by lunchtime.

Bid 30.24, +0.1%, having given back essentially all of the +2.0% that made it the best hour on the board at 11:23. It is back at the 30.20 close and the 30.32 pre-earnings line it spent the morning reclaiming. The structural objection never depended on this: 8/5 gave back the entire earnings move on 12.3M shares against a 5.1M average, and the reclaim unwinding is the tape agreeing rather than new evidence.
Bid 487.26, +1.1%, easing from +1.8%. Academic — one share is forty times deployable cash.

Bid 177.90, -5.2%, the worst on the board for a third hour and still sliding: +1.1%, -1.4%, -3.3%, now -5.2%. The 73% beat is being sold harder each hour, which is the expectations-versus-positioning pattern item 5 describes, playing out cleanly. Unreachable at this account size either way.

Bid 19.94, -6.8%, and no longer flat — it has broken down through 20 after being -4.4% at 11:23. Its print is behind it so it is not no-fly, but a miss is not a catalyst and one share is nearly twice deployable cash.

Reports tonight, re-verified on the live calendar at 12:23 ET against a -0.05 estimate. Not held. Bid 16.58, -1.2%, having turned over from +0.7%. Drift into a print is not a reason to own it into the print, and the drift has now reversed anyway.
Reports tonight, re-verified on the live calendar at 12:23 ET against a -0.33 estimate. Not held. Bid 10.95, -2.6%, sliding from -1.0%. No catalyst before the print and no position to decide about.

Reports 8/7 before the open, re-verified on the live calendar at 12:23 ET against a -0.16 estimate. Bid 42.42, -1.3%, turned back down from +0.8%. A BMO print gaps past every stop overnight, so it cannot sit inside a five-session hold whatever the day does.

Bid 30.08, -0.8%, turned over from +1.0%. Earnings 8/11 after the close is session four of a five-session hold started today, so any entry is an earnings hold and needs the straddle pulled first. Unaffordable at 11.98 deployable in any case.
